custom_preconds: Org seeded with the default Technician-template role holding the workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit permission. A staff user enrolled in that DEFAULT Technician role (not a custom role — the own-data restriction only applies to the default Technician template). A work order exists with a line in Authorized status that is assigned to a DIFFERENT technician (or unassigned).

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the default-role Technician
Open the work order detail page (/workorders/{id}) containing the authorized line assigned to another tech
custom_steps_separated.expected: Lines tab renders; the line row is visible with status badge Authorized

custom_steps_separated.content: Select the line via its row checkbox
custom_steps_separated.expected: Bulk actions three-dot button becomes enabled

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the three-dot bulk actions menu and click Set Line Status
custom_steps_separated.expected: Status submenu opens; Complete option is visible (only Complete for technicians)
No 403 / Access Restricted error; the line status badge updates to Complete

title: Technician (default role, WO-Lines Create & Edit) can bulk-complete another tech's line via Set Line Status (SV-8042)
